name: Cassandra Knight
home: the western blocks near Ferry Street Rooms
life: “I still remember pricing a view the prospective owner never wanted.” On Sunday, near the corner outside Coastal Barber, Cassandra usually checks the board before the regulars give a more colorful account of the news.
voice: I was hired to value the gift. I asked whether the young woman wanted to be a landlord at all.
appearance: Cassandra has a dark undercut with a longer wave on top, a small notch in the left eyebrow, and a favorite piece of clothing, a rust-colored canvas coat. It usually goes with a square of clean cloth for polishing smudges. When somebody else has the floor, Cassandra listens with the head tilted a little to the left.
personality: Cassandra keeps other people's confidences so well that friends sometimes mistake discretion for taking sides. Cassandra wants to be trusted and resents being asked for proof of it.
agenda: To ask the intended owner what responsibilities are welcome.
family: Quinn Pereira is Cassandra’s younger cousin. Cassandra chooses whether they walk home or sit a while. Quinn brings a spare shopping bag. That small arrangement gives both a reason to see each other on weeks when asking for company outright feels difficult. Asked about *One sleeve short*, Quinn says, “I practiced my handshake with the unaltered arm.”
connections: Tom Crane. The valuation and the tenants' explanation give the daughter a realistic picture of ownership.

reactions.situation: The daughter declines the property gift
reactions.response: Cassandra takes the daughter's preferred shop seriously before proposing another gift.

reactions.situation: An argument on the pavement makes a bystander feel unsafe
reactions.response: Cassandra stays beside the bystander in a public place and reports only what happened in sight and earshot.
